messages:
Jonas Petrov: hey team — after our SSO cutover this morning our security group lost access to the audit logs. Console shows empty list and API calls return 403. org_id: org_9x7b. We need read access restored for the security@acme.com group ASAP, remediation window is today.

Aisha Malik: thanks Jonas. can you share a quick repro (curl that returns 403) and the user email or group id? also did you migrate to the new OIDC mapping recently or was it a SAML -> OIDC change?

Jonas Petrov: repro below, token is redacted:

```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ...REDACTED..." \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9x7b/audit/logs?start=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-15T00:00:00Z"
```

Response:

```json
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "message": "token missing required scope: audit:read"
}
```

Group: security@acme.com (IdP group id: grp-87b2)

Aisha Malik: OK. that error message lines up with a missing scope mapping on the IdP side or the OIDC token not containing our audit scope. tagging @Liam to check server logs for the trace id if Jonas can paste it. also, Priya from compliance since retention entitlement may also be involved.

Liam O'Connor: on it. can you paste the full response headers (we want x-request-id/x-trace-id)? I can also search for 403s from org_9x7b in the auth service.

Jonas Petrov: added headers: x-request-id: r-9f2c, x-trace-id: t-20260315-5a9. pasted below.

infra-bot: New support escalation ticket created: INC-7832 assigned to eng-auth.

Liam O'Connor: pulled the trace. auth service responded 403 with error code AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE. IdP token decoded payload shows scopes array ONLY contains ["openid","email","profile"]. snippet from the decoded token:

```json
{
  "sub": "user|12345",
  "email": "security@acme.com",
  "scopes": ["openid","email","profile"],
  "iss": "https://idp.acme.com/",
  "aud": "redwood-client"
}
```

So the token doesn't include our audit scope (audit:read). two common causes: (1) IdP mapping rule not adding the audit scope on assertion, (2) our backend mapping of IdP group->entitlement didn't apply (SCIM/SCIM groups mapping gap).

Priya Shah: from compliance — if the token lacks audit read scope AND the org lacks the retention entitlement, users will not see historical logs. entitlements we check are: ["audit_logs.read", "audit_logs.retention:30d"]. can you confirm whether the org has a retention entitlement currently? If retention flag absent, console will hide logs even for read-capable tokens.

Aisha Malik: Jonas, quick check: can you run the admin query (requires org admin) and paste result?

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \
  "https://console.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9x7b/entitlements"
```

Expected response to include something like:

```json
{
  "entitlements": ["audit_logs.read","audit_logs.retention:30d"]
}
```

Jonas Petrov: ran it and got:

```json
{
  "entitlements": ["basic_support","audit_logs.read:trial"]
}
```

So looks like retention entitlement is missing and the audit_logs.read looks like a trial tokenized entry (audit_logs.read:trial) — not granting full read.

Liam O'Connor: that explains behaviour: token missing scope -> 403 for API calls; and retention missing -> UI hides older logs. two fixes available: (A) update IdP to emit audit:read scope (preferred long-term), (B) map the IdP group to the entitlement server-side as a temporary workaround (grant audit_logs.read and audit_logs.retention:30d on org). I can patch the entitlement mapping for org_9x7b if you confirm approval.

Priya Shah: compliance sign-off needed for retention extension. Jonas, please confirm security team approves 30 day retention entitlement and list the purpose. This is required for auditability for their incident response.

Jonas Petrov: confirmed — security approved, purpose: post-migration audit and ongoing SOC reviews. Please apply 30d retention and restore read access.

Aisha Malik: ok I've escalated in INC-7832 to eng-auth and eng-ops with owner @Liam. next steps: (1) eng-ops to grant org entitlement as temporary fix, (2) IdP admin to add scope mapping in their OIDC config (audit:read) for subsequent tokens, (3) follow-up to remove temporary entitlement if IdP fix is in place and tokens include scope. timeline target: 2 hours for temp entitlement.

Liam O'Connor: applying temporary entitlement now. command I used (internal admin API):

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-admin>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_9x7b","entitlement":"audit_logs.retention:30d"}' \
  "https://admin.internal/v1/orgs/entitlements"
```

Response: 200 OK {"status":"entitlement_applied","id":"e-4492"}

Also applied audit_logs.read full entitlement.

infra-bot: INC-7832 updated: entitlement e-4492 applied to org_9x7b by liam.o

Aisha Malik: can Jonas run the original curl again?

Jonas Petrov: re-ran the call — now returns 200 and sample payload: 

```json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "logs": [
    {"when":"2026-03-10T14:12:03Z","actor":"security@acme.com","action":"api_key.regenerate","details":"redacted"}
  ],
  "next_page": null
}
```

Jonas Petrov: confirmed, UI shows logs too. thanks. :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: marking compliance approval recorded in INC-7832. note: we'll audit entitlement usage and if the IdP fix lands we'll recommend rolling back the org-level temp entitlement to maintain least privilege.

Aisha Malik: thanks everyone. next actions:
- Liam: follow up with eng-auth to add a permanent IdP mapping story (INC-7832 -> story ENG-9981) so tokens include audit:read for that IdP group.
- Ops: monitor for any related regressions for 24h.
- Jonas: keep us posted if anything else pops up.

Jonas Petrov: will do, thank you all!

infra-bot: INC-7832 status changed to RESOLVED by liam.o — temporary entitlement applied, customer verified.

Aisha Malik: closing thread. reopen if anything else.
